description_en: Quickly and accurately detects key field information contained in medical device manufacturing licenses, such as license number, legal representative, company name, registered address, production address, production scope, responsible person, and validity period
description_zh: 可快速精准的识别医疗器械生产许可证所包含许可证编号、法定代表人、企业名称、注册地址、生产地址、生产范围、企业负责人、有效期限等关键字段信息
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-medical-device-produce-license --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB13MJ.MuT2gK0jSZFvXXXnFXXa-1417-994.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeMedicalDeviceProduceLicense

parameters.help_en: Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; Base64 encoding is not supported)
parameters.help_zh: 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB. Either this parameter or URL must be provided. When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary file in the HTTP body. When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body
parameters.help_zh: 图片二进制文件，最大10MB，与URL二选一。 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body 中上传即可。 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if detection succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
